```{=html}
<div class="warmup">

<div class="box">
  <strong>Practice Warm-up Test</strong>
  <p>This is a practice test and does not count towards your grade. You will receive one task from the pool assigned to your seminar group.</p>
  <p class="small"><strong>Prototype:</strong> submission is stored only in this browser. The production version will submit to the course backend.</p>
</div>

<div id="setup" class="box">
  <div class="row">
    <div class="field">
      <label for="neptun"><strong>Neptun code</strong></label>
      <input id="neptun" maxlength="6" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Neptun code">
    </div>
    <div class="field">
      <label for="group"><strong>Seminar group</strong></label>
      <select id="group">
        <option value="">Select your group…</option>
        <option value="group01">Seminar Group 1</option>
        <option value="group02">Seminar Group 2</option>
        <option value="group03">Seminar Group 3</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <button id="start" class="primary" type="button">Start Warm-up Test</button>
  </div>
  <div id="setup-msg" class="small" style="margin-top:10px">Enter your Neptun code and select your seminar group.</div>
</div>

<div id="test" class="hidden">
  <div class="box">
    <div class="topline">
      <div><strong>Practice Warm-up Test – Week 3</strong><br>
      <span id="identity" class="small"></span></div>
      <div>Time remaining: <span id="timer" class="timer">10:00</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="box">
    <div class="small">Task variant: <span id="variant"></span></div>
    <h2>Your task</h2>
    <div id="task" class="task"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="box">
    <label for="code"><strong>Your Python code</strong></label>
    <textarea id="code" class="code" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
    <div style="margin-top:10px">
      <button id="run" type="button">▶ Run</button>
      <button id="submit" class="primary" type="button">Submit</button>
    </div>
    <p><strong>Output</strong></p>
    <pre id="output"></pre>
    <div class="small">Runs: <span id="runs">0</span></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="finished" class="hidden success">
  <h2 id="finish-title">Submission successful.</h2>
  <p id="finish-text">Your solution has been submitted successfully. Your result will be available by the next class at the latest.</p>
  <div id="finish-meta" class="small"></div>
</div>

</div>
```

<script>
const WARMUP_CONFIG = {
  week: "03",
  practice: true,
  durationMinutes: 10
};

// Prototype group names: replace these with the real seminar groups later.
const GROUP_LABELS = {
  group01: "Seminar Group 1",
  group02: "Seminar Group 2",
  group03: "Seminar Group 3"
};

// Six different but comparable tasks per group.
// All use only Week 1–3 material: input, simple data types, calculations,
// conditional statements and output.
const WARMUP_POOLS = {
  group01: [
    {id:"w03_g01_a", text:`Ask for the <strong>price of a product</strong> and the <strong>discount percentage</strong>. Calculate the discounted price. If the discounted price is at least 20,000 HUF, print <code>High-value purchase</code>; otherwise print <code>Regular purchase</code>. Display the discounted price as well.`},
    {id:"w03_g01_b", text:`Ask for a student's <strong>two test scores</strong> (0–100). Calculate the average. If the average is at least 60, print <code>Passed</code>; otherwise print <code>Failed</code>. Display the average too.`},
    {id:"w03_g01_c", text:`Ask for the <strong>distance travelled in kilometres</strong> and the <strong>fuel used in litres</strong>. Calculate litres per 100 km. If consumption is at most 6.0, print <code>Economical</code>; otherwise print <code>High consumption</code>. Display the calculated consumption.`},
    {id:"w03_g01_d", text:`Ask for the <strong>number of hours worked</strong> and the <strong>hourly wage</strong>. Calculate the wage. If the calculated wage is at least 100,000 HUF, print <code>Large payment</code>; otherwise print <code>Standard payment</code>. Display the wage.`},
    {id:"w03_g01_e", text:`Ask for a temperature in <strong>degrees Celsius</strong>. Convert it to Fahrenheit using <code>F = C × 9 / 5 + 32</code>. If the Celsius temperature is below 0, print <code>Freezing</code>; otherwise print <code>Above freezing</code>. Display the Fahrenheit value.`},
    {id:"w03_g01_f", text:`Ask for the <strong>length and width of a rectangle</strong>. Calculate its area. If the area is greater than 100, print <code>Large rectangle</code>; otherwise print <code>Small rectangle</code>. Display the area.`}
  ],
  group02: [
    {id:"w03_g02_a", text:`Ask for the <strong>net price</strong> of a product and the <strong>VAT rate</strong> as a percentage. Calculate the gross price. If the gross price is greater than 50,000 HUF, print <code>Expensive</code>; otherwise print <code>Affordable</code>. Display the gross price.`},
    {id:"w03_g02_b", text:`Ask for a person's <strong>height in metres</strong> and <strong>weight in kilograms</strong>. Calculate BMI as <code>weight / height²</code>. If BMI is below 25, print <code>Below 25</code>; otherwise print <code>25 or above</code>. Display the BMI.`},
    {id:"w03_g02_c", text:`Ask for the <strong>amount of money in HUF</strong> and a <strong>HUF/EUR exchange rate</strong> (HUF for 1 EUR). Calculate the amount in EUR. If the result is at least 100 EUR, print <code>At least 100 EUR</code>; otherwise print <code>Less than 100 EUR</code>. Display the EUR amount.`},
    {id:"w03_g02_d", text:`Ask for the <strong>base salary</strong> and a <strong>bonus percentage</strong>. Calculate the salary including the bonus. If the bonus amount itself is at least 50,000 HUF, print <code>High bonus</code>; otherwise print <code>Standard bonus</code>. Display the final salary.`},
    {id:"w03_g02_e", text:`Ask for the <strong>number of items</strong> purchased and the <strong>unit price</strong>. Calculate the total price. If at least 10 items were purchased, apply a 10% discount. Display the final price and print whether a discount was applied.`},
    {id:"w03_g02_f", text:`Ask for the <strong>radius of a circle</strong>. Use <code>3.14</code> for π and calculate the area. If the area is at least 50, print <code>Large circle</code>; otherwise print <code>Small circle</code>. Display the area.`}
  ],
  group03: [
    {id:"w03_g03_a", text:`Ask for the <strong>original price</strong> and a <strong>price increase percentage</strong>. Calculate the new price. If the increase is more than 10%, print <code>Significant increase</code>; otherwise print <code>Small increase</code>. Display the new price.`},
    {id:"w03_g03_b", text:`Ask for the <strong>number of pages in a book</strong> and the <strong>number of pages already read</strong>. Calculate the percentage completed. If at least 50% has been read, print <code>More than halfway</code>; otherwise print <code>Less than halfway</code>. Display the percentage.`},
    {id:"w03_g03_c", text:`Ask for the <strong>length of a journey in kilometres</strong> and the <strong>travel time in hours</strong>. Calculate average speed. If the speed is greater than 90 km/h, print <code>Fast journey</code>; otherwise print <code>Normal journey</code>. Display the average speed.`},
    {id:"w03_g03_d", text:`Ask for a student's <strong>three marks</strong>. Calculate the average. If every mark is at least 40 and the average is at least 50, print <code>Passed</code>; otherwise print <code>Failed</code>. Display the average.`},
    {id:"w03_g03_e", text:`Ask for the <strong>monthly income</strong> and <strong>monthly expenses</strong>. Calculate the balance. If the balance is positive, print <code>Surplus</code>; otherwise print <code>No surplus</code>. Display the balance.`},
    {id:"w03_g03_f", text:`Ask for the <strong>weight of a parcel in kilograms</strong> and the <strong>price per kilogram</strong>. Calculate the shipping cost. If the parcel weighs more than 5 kg, add a 1,500 HUF surcharge. Display the final shipping cost and whether the surcharge was added.`}
  ]
};

const STORAGE_KEY = "pycourse_warmup_week03_prototype";
let pyodide = null;
let ticker = null;

function validNeptun(v){ return /^[A-Z0-9]{6}$/.test((v||"").trim().toUpperCase()); }
function esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;"); }
function loadState(){ try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)||"null")}catch{return null} }
function saveState(s){ localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(s)); }

function hashString(str){
  let h = 2166136261;
  for(let i=0;i<str.length;i++){ h ^= str.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h,16777619); }
  return h >>> 0;
}
function assignedTask(neptun, group){
  const pool=WARMUP_POOLS[group];
  const idx=hashString(neptun+"|"+WARMUP_CONFIG.week+"|"+group)%pool.length;
  return pool[idx];
}
function formatRemaining(ms){
  const sec=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(ms/1000));
  return String(Math.floor(sec/60)).padStart(2,"0")+":"+String(sec%60).padStart(2,"0");
}

async function ensurePy(){
  if(!pyodide) pyodide=await loadPyodide();
}
function inputPrompts(code){
  const rx=/input\s*\(\s*(?:(["'])(.*?)\1)?\s*\)/g;
  let a=[],m; while((m=rx.exec(code))!==null)a.push(m[2]||"Enter a value:");
  return a;
}
async function execute(code, inputs){
  await ensurePy();
  pyodide.globals.set("student_code",code);
  pyodide.globals.set("student_inputs_json",JSON.stringify(inputs.map(String)));
  const x=await pyodide.runPythonAsync(`
import json,builtins,io,contextlib
def _run(src, vals):
    it=iter(json.loads(vals)); out=io.StringIO()
    def inp(prompt=""):
        try: value=next(it)
        except StopIteration: raise EOFError("No more input values.")
        if prompt: print(prompt,end="")
        print(value)
        return value
    old=builtins.input
    try:
        builtins.input=inp
        ns={"__name__":"__main__"}
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out),contextlib.redirect_stderr(out):
            exec(compile(src,"<student_code>","exec"),ns,ns)
        return json.dumps({"ok":True,"output":out.getvalue().strip()})
    except Exception as e:
        return json.dumps({"ok":False,"output":out.getvalue().strip(),"error":type(e).__name__+": "+str(e)})
    finally: builtins.input=old
_run(student_code,student_inputs_json)
`);
  return JSON.parse(String(x));
}

function showTest(s){
  document.getElementById("setup").classList.add("hidden");
  document.getElementById("finished").classList.add("hidden");
  document.getElementById("test").classList.remove("hidden");
  document.getElementById("identity").textContent=`${s.neptun} · ${GROUP_LABELS[s.group]}`;
  document.getElementById("variant").textContent=s.variant;
  document.getElementById("task").innerHTML=s.taskText;
  document.getElementById("code").value=s.code||"";
  document.getElementById("runs").textContent=s.runs||0;
  startTicker();
}
function showFinished(s){
  document.getElementById("setup").classList.add("hidden");
  document.getElementById("test").classList.add("hidden");
  document.getElementById("finished").classList.remove("hidden");
  const auto=s.submissionType==="timeout";
  document.getElementById("finish-title").textContent=auto
    ?"Time is up. Your solution has been submitted automatically."
    :"Submission successful.";
  document.getElementById("finish-text").textContent=
    "Your result will be available by the next class at the latest.";
  document.getElementById("finish-meta").textContent=
    `Prototype local submission · ${GROUP_LABELS[s.group]} · Variant ${s.variant} · ${new Date(s.submittedAt).toLocaleString()}`;
}
function startTicker(){
  clearInterval(ticker);
  updateTimer();
  ticker=setInterval(updateTimer,250);
}
function updateTimer(){
  const s=loadState(); if(!s||s.submitted)return;
  const remaining=s.deadline-Date.now();
  document.getElementById("timer").textContent=formatRemaining(remaining);
  if(remaining<=0) submitTest("timeout");
}
function persistCode(){
  const s=loadState(); if(!s||s.submitted)return;
  s.code=document.getElementById("code").value;
  saveState(s);
}
async function runCode(){
  let s=loadState(); if(!s||s.submitted)return;
  persistCode(); s=loadState();
  const prompts=inputPrompts(s.code); let vals=[];
  for(const p of prompts.length?prompts:["Enter input value:"]){
    const v=window.prompt(p); if(v===null)return; vals.push(v);
  }
  s.runs=(s.runs||0)+1; saveState(s);
  document.getElementById("runs").textContent=s.runs;
  const r=await execute(s.code,vals);
  document.getElementById("output").textContent=r.ok?r.output:(r.output?r.output+"\n":"")+r.error;
}
function submitTest(type="manual"){
  let s=loadState(); if(!s||s.submitted)return;
  if(document.getElementById("code")) s.code=document.getElementById("code").value;
  s.submitted=true;
  s.submissionType=type;
  s.submittedAt=Date.now();
  // PROTOTYPE ONLY: replace this local save with an authenticated backend call.
  saveState(s);
  clearInterval(ticker);
  showFinished(s);
}
function startTest(){
  const n=document.getElementById("neptun").value.trim().toUpperCase();
  const g=document.getElementById("group").value;
  const msg=document.getElementById("setup-msg");
  if(!validNeptun(n)){msg.textContent="Please enter a valid 6-character Neptun code.";return;}
  if(!g){msg.textContent="Please select your seminar group.";return;}
  const t=assignedTask(n,g), now=Date.now();
  const s={
    neptun:n, group:g, variant:t.id, taskText:t.text,
    startedAt:now, deadline:now+WARMUP_CONFIG.durationMinutes*60*1000,
    code:"", runs:0, submitted:false
  };
  saveState(s); showTest(s);
}
function restore(){
  const s=loadState(); if(!s)return;
  if(s.submitted){showFinished(s);return;}
  if(Date.now()>=s.deadline){submitTest("timeout");return;}
  showTest(s);
}

document.getElementById("start").addEventListener("click",startTest);
document.getElementById("run").addEventListener("click",runCode);
document.getElementById("submit").addEventListener("click",()=>submitTest("manual"));
document.getElementById("code").addEventListener("input",persistCode);
window.addEventListener("beforeunload",persistCode);
restore();
</script>
